prompts.resources: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square resource illustration for the top resource bar of an original space strategy game called Orion Reach. Plain very dark blue-black backdrop. Single large central object cluster fills 80 percent of the square; must read instantly at 58 pixels. No text, letters, numbers, UI frame, symbols or logos. Emphasize useful raw construction materials, rugged rock texture and silver metal sheen. Warm copper/bronze accent color. No crystals, gems, gold coins, tools or humans.
